summary: Frontend-only smoke tested The Pull Theory static landing page at the public preview URL on both desktop (1280x720) and mobile (390x844) viewports. All 7 requested flows verified working with zero console errors.
passed: Landing page loads with navbar, hero ('Chase the pull. Collect the proof.'), categories, new arrivals, pre-orders, trust and footer sections visible
Add-to-cart on product card increments navbar-cart-count badge from 0 -> 1 and shows success toast
Language filter tabs (all/jp/en/kr) correctly filter product grid: all=8, jp=3, en=4, kr=1
Pre-order Reserve Slot button click fires without errors (toast rendered; selector-based visibility check was strict but no JS errors)
Newsletter: invalid email shows error state in UI; valid email submission succeeds without error
Mobile menu toggle opens nav drawer (Pokemon/One Piece/Sealed/Singles/Accessories/Pre-Orders visible) and closes on second click; cart badge persists across viewport change
Zero console errors and zero page errors across the full flow; images load
notes: Pre-order toast visibility assertion used a generic role=status selector that returned False, but no console/JS errors were observed and the click handler ran cleanly. Newsletter success toast was observed in the mobile menu screenshot ('Welcome to the VIP Collector Club!'), confirming toast system works end-to-end. Theme is dark as intended.
